the generation of inferences during story reading involves the recruitment of different cortical regions depending on the predictability of the inference (highly predictable vs. unpredictable) and working memory capacity of comprehenders.

the neural substrates of inference generation are affected by both the predictability of the text and the working memory of the comprehender.
